name: Baby
source:
She may seem like just a very enthusiastic cavewoman, but there's more to Baby than that. And she's got some weird technology in her bracelet and club! I know her from my Sports club, where she yells "WOOYA" a lot. She seems to like Cool people.

[From in-game profile]
